title: Banana honey oat breakfast bake
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Banana honey oat breakfast bake. Ingredient reference: Rolled oats, Banana, Honey, Milk, Eggs, Butter. Preparation reference: One batch makes 4 portions. Preparation: 10 minutes; cooking: 30 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 5 minutes. Heat the oven to 180 C conventional and grease a 20 cm square baking dish with the butter. Peel and mash the bananas in a bowl. Beat in the egg, honey and milk, then stir in the rolled oats. Pour into the dish, spread level and bake for 30 minutes, until the middle is set and the edges turn golden. Leave for 5 minutes, then cut into four pieces. Serve warm..
